call_purpose: Some of your students say the course lesson videos keep loading and never play, mostly on their phones, and you wanted this fixed.

covered.text: We opened one affected lesson link on a desktop browser, Safari and a phone, and the video played each time, so we could not reproduce the problem from our side. This is not yet resolved.

customer_next_steps.text: Ask one affected student to record a short screen recording of the video loading and send it to us along with the lesson link.

support_next_steps.text: We will raise this with our team and get back to you.
